summary: Frontend E2E test of the TruTown redesign (desktop 1920x1080 + mobile 390x844). All 11 landing sections render, no console/page errors, all 3 line-art PNGs load (200) and reveal (clip-path ends at inset(0 0% 0 0)). Desktop nav: all 5 links land at ~88px; mobile menu: all 5 links land at ~76px and the menu closes. FAQ: all 11 items (0-10) open and close. Contact modal: validation shows 3 errors on an empty submit; one valid submit returned POST /api/contact 200, showed the success state and the 'Message sent!' toast, then the modal closed by itself. Footer legal links go to /privacy, /terms and /delete-account, each with a dark title band, navbar and footer; legal-back-home returns to /. Going from /privacy to Safeguards lands on /#features (top=112px). /item/nonexistent-123 shows a clean 'Unable to load listing' error card under a solid dark navbar. Two real bugs found: (1) horizontal scroll overflow on both mobile and desktop, caused by the rotated and scaled ExhaleMoment ticker; (2) text typed into the contact form inputs is almost invisible.

ui_bugs.issue: Horizontal page overflow. Mobile 390px: scrollWidth=397. Desktop 1920px: scrollWidth=1950. Cause: <section data-testid='exhale-moment-section'> uses '-rotate-[1.2deg] scale-[1.03]', which makes it 403px wide on a 390px screen, and no ancestor has overflow-x hidden or clip. html and body both have overflow-x: visible.

Typed text in every field (name, email, subject select, message) is rgb(207,199,179) on a white background, so it is nearly invisible and lighter than the placeholder. The modal is rendered inside the dark Footer and picks up the footer's light text colour. Fix: add an explicit dark text class (e.g. text-ink or text-stone-900) to the input, select and textarea classNames.

issues: The decorative giant quote mark (absolute -top-16 left-6, text-[16rem]) is mostly cut off by overflow-hidden and shows only as two small green slivers at the card's top-left edge. It looks like a rendering glitch. Move it down or drop it.
The handshake line art runs behind the body paragraph and the store buttons. It is still readable, but the strokes cross the text.
The page is shorter than the viewport, so a cream blank area shows below the footer. Add min-h-screen with flex so the footer sits at the bottom.
Large empty gap (~100px) between the title band and the first divider or heading. There is probably an empty intro block.
After clicking the footer link, scrollY was 14 instead of 0 (small offset; ScrollToTop runs before the layout settles).

action_items: Fix horizontal overflow from the ExhaleMoment rotate/scale. Either wrap the section in a div with overflow-x-hidden (or overflow-x: clip), or add overflow-x: clip on html/body. Then re-verify scrollWidth <= 390 on mobile and <= 1920 on desktop.
Give the ContactModal input, select and textarea an explicit dark text colour (text-ink or text-stone-900). Currently typed text inherits the footer's light colour.
Optional: fix the clipped quote mark on the Testimonials card, the blank area below the footer on the item page, and the empty gap on /delete-account.
critical_code_review_comments: ContactModal falls back to an empty BACKEND_URL ('') when REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is missing. That hides a missing config instead of failing fast.
ContactModal is mounted inside Footer, so it inherits the footer's text colours (this causes the input contrast bug). Consider rendering it in a portal or at App level.

success_rate.frontend: 90% - all functional flows pass; horizontal overflow and input contrast bugs found

seed_data_creation: Sent one contact message (id ca5e110c-de3a-47a9-9ddb-11fdc2d1c101, name 'TEST_Agent Redesign', email test.agent@example.com). This sent a real email to info@trutown.market.
context_for_next_testing_agent: No auth. Nav offsets verified at 88px desktop and 76px mobile. Re-check: document.documentElement.scrollWidth at 390 and 1920, and getComputedStyle(contact-input-name).color. Do not send more than one contact email per run.
rca of the issue: Overflow: CSS transforms (rotate + scale 1.03) on a full-width block element grow its painted box past the viewport. Overflow-hidden on the section itself only clips its children, not the section, and no ancestor clips on the x-axis. Contrast: the inputs have no text-colour class, so they inherit the light colour set on the Footer wrapper where ContactModal is rendered.
